displayName: 假面骑士极狐 Kamen Rider Geats
description: Unofficial Kamen Rider Geats fan-art companion in a stylized Magnum Boost form. Original harmless choreography includes checking belt controls, settling the white scarf, tossing a tiny coin and correcting a coin-storage fumble. The coin and storage slot are invented desktop props, not a canonical transformation mechanism. White fox helmet and upper armor, orange lenses, black suit and vermilion leg armor retain simplified panel details. Three articulated running directions and a small jump use no gun, attack or target; no official endorsement.
author: Cozy Critters Studio
